images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: landscape 16:9 hero for the Ada Tours press and media page. Create an elegant travel editorial still life on a sunlit pale stone desk beside a large window overlooking Rio de Janeiro and Guanabara Bay, the recognisable Sugarloaf silhouette in the soft distant view. In the foreground at the right: a real-looking compact professional camera, a closed warm ivory linen notebook and two loose unbranded photographic prints of Brazilian nature, slightly overlapping. The left half is a calm continuous window and natural bay view with room for large website text added later. The picture must be a single coherent scene, tasteful and realistic, not a collage. Warm white, natural greenery and ocean blue; soft afternoon daylight, detailed natural textures. Wide cinematic 16:9 composition, main objects remain visible in central crop. No people, no letters, no headlines, no newspaper mastheads, no logos, no awards, no watermarks, no borders, no dark overlay. This is illustrative travel imagery, not documentary evidence of a real Ada Tours office or press coverage.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: landscape 16:9 website hero for professional webinars about Latin American travel. Create a refined, bright and realistic online travel presentation workspace: an understated charcoal studio microphone and headphones on a pale wooden desk, a slim open laptop showing only a soft out-of-focus natural landscape without any interface text, a leafy Brazilian tropical garden and a luminous veranda in the background. No people. The camera sees the workspace from a gentle diagonal angle; microphone and laptop are to the right of the central area, the left half has calm soft foliage and light space for website typography added later. Premium editorial travel photography, soft daylight, warm neutral tones, true materials and natural depth of field. Landscape 16:9, uncluttered, credible scale. No logos, no letters, no branded meeting app, no text, no collage, no watermark, no border, no pre-applied dark gradient. Illustrative webinar setting, do not imply a documentary photograph of a particular named office.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: landscape 16:9 hero for Ada Tours international travel partnerships. Create a refined documentary-style travel landscape of a wooden passenger launch moving slowly across the calm blue-green water of Guanabara Bay in Rio de Janeiro, seen from a tasteful modern waterfront terrace. A simple light stone railing at the bottom edge; the small elegant boat is in the middle distance and the unmistakable Sugarloaf Mountain rises beyond the bay, with authentic tropical coastal vegetation. Broad airy composition conveys connection across places and travel, no business stock-photo cliches. The sky and water on the left remain uncluttered for website text added later; mountain and boat near the middle-right but safe in a central mobile crop. Bright natural early morning light, believable Brazil geography, exquisite realistic water and foliage texture, soft warm whites and ocean blues. One scene, landscape 16:9. No identifiable people, no flags, no logos, no text, no maps, no graphic network lines, no handshake, no watermarks, no border, no dark overlay. Illustrative destination image, not evidence of ownership or a specific operated excursion.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: portrait for the Ada Tours webinars page. Input image 1 is the exact edit target: the existing portrait of Anna Avanesova. Improve image quality only: increase clean sharpness, fine hair detail and clarity, reduce compression and noisy edges while preserving this exact photograph and person's identity. Keep the same age, face proportions, features, natural skin texture, facial expression, hair, earrings, clothes, shoulder straps, background, colors, camera perspective and original square framing. No beauty retouching, no skin smoothing, no age change, no new objects, no removal, no repositioning, no background replacement, no creative crop, no artificial canvas extension. No text, borders or watermark. Preserve a natural photographic appearance. This is conservative restoration, not a new portrait.
